_readme: Hand-written relations inside the immune proof case, 2026-09-10. Same discipline as civic_relations.json: every relation carries a source and a falsifier and passes the same validator as one created through the API. All three parts sit on the cell rung, so these are horizontal.

shapes.sh_self_bounds_defence: What counts as self bounds what may be defended and remembered.

relations.note: The thymus produces regulatory T cells; the boundary and its restraint are made in one place.
relations.source_ref: fractal_operational_core.md §5 — The immune system is the proof case
relations.falsifier: Regulatory T cells maturing with no thymic selection at all would break this.

relations.note: What the thymus admits as self bounds what memory may later recognise as foreign.
relations.source_ref: fractal_operational_core.md §5 — The immune system is the proof case
relations.falsifier: A durable memory response against a shape the thymus had taught as self, with no autoimmunity, would break this.
